articles.title: Bitcoin, ether little-changed despite record stocks, falling oil and easing war fears
articles.snippet: Global stocks hit records and oil cracked on a tentative US-Iran ceasefire extension. Crypto stayed on the sidelines, with some analysts saying the next catalyst is regulatory, not geopolitical.

articles.title: Wintermute Is Providing Liquidity on Kalshi and Polymarket, Linking Two Giants
articles.snippet: Wintermute is providing liquidity on the two biggest prediction markets, linking flows for both firms, according to a source familiar with the matter.

articles.title: Ukrainian Police Officers Allegedly Kidnapped Crypto Entrepreneurs to Extort Millions
articles.snippet: Prosecutors say two police colonels organized an extortion ring that allegedly tracked, abducted, and held crypto entrepreneurs at gunpoint.

articles.title: Google Engineer Charged Over $2.75 Million in Alleged Polymarket Insider Trading Bets
articles.snippet: The Google employee case is the second federal prosecution tied to alleged prediction market insider trading on Polymarket.
